is_disabled.Description: Check whether a feature is greyed out

is_open.Description: Whether ClickUI or List UI is currently showing. Use it to hide an overlay while the user is in the menu

is_player_feature.Description: Whether a widget is flagged as acting on the selected player

is_saveable.Description: Whether a feature persists, and the key it uses

mount_targets.Description: List every native path menu.attach accepts in this build, as { path = "self>main", label = "Self > Main" }

on_player_change.Description: Run a callback whenever the selected player changes: callback(player_id, player_name), with player_id nil when the selection was cleared. Fires once per change, not per frame. Returns a handler id for menu.remove_handler

on_tick_in_view.Description: Run a callback every frame the element is ACTUALLY drawn — cheaper than a script-wide polling loop for live readonly rows. Registering again replaces the previous handler

remove_handler.Description: Remove an on_player_change handler by its id, or an element's on_tick_in_view handler by passing the element

reset.Description: Restore a feature to its default and fire its callback

save_state.Description: Force a write now. Omit the id to flush every saveable widget this script owns

set_accent.Signature: menu.set_accent(feature: any, r: number = nil, g: number = nil, b: number = nil, a: number = 255)
set_accent.Description: Recolour the active part of a widget - a toggle's on state, a slider's fill, a button's body. Components above 1 are read as 0-255, otherwise as 0-1. Call with no colour to restore the theme accent

set_confirm.Description: Make a button ask for confirmation before firing. Pass "" to clear it

set_default.Description: Overwrite the value menu.reset restores. Every add_* already records its starting value as the default, so this is only needed to change it

set_disabled.Signature: menu.set_disabled(feature: any, disabled: bool, reason: string = "")
set_disabled.Description: Grey a feature out without hiding it. The reason shows as its tooltip/description

set_fast_step.Description: Coarse increment for numeric inputs (ImGui's ctrl-click / held +- step)

set_format.Description: printf format for the value shown next to a numeric widget, e.g. "%d%%" or "%.1f m/s". Pass "" to restore the default

set_hotkey.Signature: menu.set_hotkey(feature: any, key: int | table) -> boolean
set_hotkey.Description: Bind a key (or a chord) to a feature. Accepts one input.keys value, or a table where every entry but the last must be HELD and the last must be freshly PRESSED. The binding is shown next to the feature in both UIs, appears automatically in the HOTKEYS overlay and Hotkeys page while the script is loaded, and fires exactly as a click would

set_icon.Description: Set the icon glyph shown before an element's name. Works on any element, not just main tabs

set_name.Description: Rename a Lua-created tab, subtab, category or widget at runtime

set_open.Description: Set menu visibility. False closes ClickUI and ListUI; repeated calls are idempotent.

set_options.Description: Replace a combo or list_action's options at runtime. Same table shapes as add_list_action; a stale combo selection is clamped

set_parent.Description: Move an element and its whole subtree under a different parent. Refuses to create a cycle

set_precision.Description: Decimal places shown on a float widget (0-9)

set_rainbow.Description: Cycle a colour picker's hue every frame. The change callback does NOT fire while cycling — read the live colour with menu.get_value instead

set_range.Signature: menu.set_range(feature: any, min: number, max: number)
set_range.Description: Retune a slider or numeric input's min/max at runtime. The current value is clamped into the new range

set_size.Signature: menu.set_size(feature: any, width: number, height: number = 0)
set_size.Description: Width (and optional height) in unscaled pixels for a widget's interactive part. The frontend applies the user's UI scale, so a script never needs to know it. 0 restores auto-sizing

set_step.Description: How far one left/right press moves the value. Applies to sliders and numeric inputs in both UIs

set_style.Description: Pick the widget presentation instead of following the menu theme. Toggles: "switch", "checkbox", "box", "radio", "text", "button_toggle". Sliders: "bar", "modern", "drag", "input", "stepper". Combos: "dropdown", "stepper", "radio", "buttons". Buttons: "plain", "accent", "danger", "link". "auto" restores the theme default. A name that does not apply to the element's kind is ignored, so one style is safe to set across a mixed group. List UI honours the toggle looks and draws "stepper"/"input"/"drag" as value-only rows

set_text_color.Signature: menu.set_text_color(feature: any, r: number = nil, g: number = nil, b: number = nil, a: number = 255)
set_text_color.Description: Recolour a feature's label. Same colour conventions as set_accent; no colour restores the theme

set_value.Description: Set feature value. On a Readonly this sets the right-hand text; on a Text element it sets the label

toggle.Description: Open/close ClickUI, returning the new state

trigger.Description: Fire an element's callback from script, as if it had been clicked

add_page.Signature: features.add_page(label: string, ids: string[]) -> integer | nil, error: string?
add_page.Description: Game callback. Register a script-owned native feature page in BOTH ClickUI and ListUI Lua Content. Uses the actual command widgets and active native theme. Up to 64 pages per script, 256 exact IDs per page. Unload removes the owning script's pages.
add_page.Example:
local page = assert(features.add_page('My Self Tools', {'godmode'}))
-- Visible in ClickUI and ListUI Lua Content.
-- features.remove_page(page) removes it early.

call.Signature: features.call(id: string) -> boolean | nil, error: string?
call.Description: Game callback only. Executes an action through the main menu's Command.Call access checks. Value commands use features.set. IDs come from features.list, independently for each game.
call.Example:
script.run_in_fiber(function()
 for _, feature in ipairs(assert(features.list())) do
  if feature.type == 'action' then log.info(feature.id) end
 end
end)

get.Signature: features.get(id: string) -> Feature | nil, error: string?
get.Description: Game callback only. Fresh snapshot of the same command used by the main GUI and hotkeys. No raw pointers or private copied setting.
get.Example:
script.run_in_fiber(function()
 local feature, err = features.get('godmode')
 if feature then log.info(tostring(feature.value)) else log.info(err) end
end)

list.Signature: features.list(filter: string = '') -> Feature[] | nil, error: string?
list.Description: Game callback only. Sorted snapshots of registered host commands, with exact IDs, type, value, label, description, account availability, numeric bounds and list options. Case-sensitive substring filter matches ID or label. Runtime permission controls are excluded.
list.Example:
script.run_in_fiber(function()
 for _, feature in ipairs(assert(features.list('godmode'))) do
  log.info(feature.id .. ': ' .. tostring(feature.value))
 end
end)

remove_page.Signature: features.remove_page(pageId: integer) -> boolean | nil, error: string?
remove_page.Description: Game callback. Remove only a page owned by this Lua state. Returns false if missing or owned by another state. Retained native-page snapshots become inactive on removal or unload.

set.Signature: features.set(id: string, value: boolean|number|string|table) -> Feature | nil, error: string?
set.Description: Game callback only. Calls the actual typed setter, preserving callbacks and persistence. Validates type, finite numbers, integer bounds and real list option values; color/vector tables use x,y,z,w fields (colors 0..1). Preserves account restrictions. Returns the resulting snapshot, or nil and an error.
set.Example:
script.run_in_fiber(function()
 local state, err = features.set('godmode', true)
 if not state then log.info(err) end
end)

apply.Description: Game callback. Apply a captured native theme. Omit a surface to leave it alone. RDR2 listui is the complete active style profile, including its version/profileStyle; keep its identity and layout validation intact. Native settings handle persistence.
apply.Example:
script.run_in_fiber(function()
 local snapshot = ui_theme.get()
 ui_theme.apply({clickui = snapshot.clickui})
end)

get.Description: Game callback. Capture this game's current native ClickUI and ListUI settings. Snapshot schemas are game/style specific; edit captured fields rather than copying another game's raw values.
get.Example:
script.run_in_fiber(function()
 local savedTheme = ui_theme.get()
 ui_theme.set_accent(80, 160, 240)
 -- Restore later with ui_theme.apply(savedTheme).
end)
